en.s: The Alid revolt of 762–763 or Revolt of Muhammad the Pure Soul was an uprising by the Hasanid branch of the Alids against the newly established Abbasid Caliphate. The Hasanids, led by the brothers Muhammad (called "the Pure Soul") and Ibrahim, rejected the legitimacy of the Abbasid family's claim to power.
en.n: The death of Ibrahim ibn Abdallah marks the end of the Alid revolt of 762–763.

zh.s: 阿里派起义（762—763年）又称“纯洁灵魂穆罕默德起义”，是哈桑派阿里后裔反抗新建立的阿拔斯哈里发国的一场起义。由兄弟穆罕默德（称“纯洁灵魂”）和易卜拉欣率领的哈桑派，否认阿拔斯家族统治的合法性。
zh.n: 阿卜杜拉之子易卜拉欣之死标志着762—763年阿里派起义结束。

en.t: Henry II crowned Holy Roman Emperor
en.s: On 14 February 1014, Pope Benedict VIII crowned Henry II Holy Roman Emperor in St. Peter’s Basilica in Rome, on the site now within Vatican City.

zh.t: 亨利二世加冕为神圣罗马皇帝
zh.s: 1014年2月14日，教皇本笃八世在罗马圣彼得大教堂为亨利二世加冕，授予他神圣罗马皇帝称号。该旧教堂的原址位于今梵蒂冈。

en.s: The Battle of Botora (Georgian: ბოტორის ბრძოლა) was fought between the armies of the Kingdom of Georgia and the Seljuk Empire on February 14, 1120.

zh.s: 博托拉战役于1120年2月14日发生，交战双方是格鲁吉亚王国和塞尔柱帝国的军队。

en.s: A papal election was held on 14 February 1130, after the death of Pope Honorius II, and resulted in a double election. Part of the cardinals, led by Cardinal-Chancellor Aymery de la Châtre, elected Gregorio Papareschi as Innocent II, but the rest of them refused to recognize him and elected Cardinal Pietro Pierleoni, who took the name of Anacletus II.

zh.s: 1130年2月14日，教宗何诺二世去世后举行教宗选举，结果出现双重选举。一部分枢机主教由枢机国务卿艾默里·德·拉沙特尔带领，选出格雷戈里奥·帕帕雷斯基为教宗，称英诺森二世；其余枢机拒绝承认他，另选枢机主教彼得罗·皮耶莱奥尼为教宗，称阿纳克莱图斯二世。

en.s: The Battle of Thị Nại Bay was a military engagement between Champa and the Yuan dynasty in February 1283. The battle took place on the landing beach of Thị Nại Bay, near Champa's capital Vijaya (modern-day Qui Nhơn, Vietnam). Despite being outnumbered, the Yuan invaders managed to break the Cham defensive line, forced the Cham monarch Indravarman V to retreat to the western highlands, where he waged an successfully guerrilla campaign against the occupying Yuan forces.

zh.s: 提奈湾之战是占城与元朝于1283年2月发生的一场军事冲突。战斗发生在提奈湾登陆海滩，靠近占城首都毗阇耶（今越南归仁）。元军人数较少，却突破占军防线，迫使占城国王因陀罗跋摩五世退往西部高地。此后，他在那里开展游击战，抵抗占领当地的元军。

en.s: The Strasbourg massacre occurred on 14 February 1349, when the entire Jewish community of 2,000 Jews was publicly burnt to death as part of the Black Death persecutions. Starting in the spring of 1348, pogroms against Jews had occurred in European cities, starting in Toulon. By November of that year, they spread via Savoy to German-speaking territories.

zh.s: 1349年2月14日，作为黑死病迫害的一部分，斯特拉斯堡整个犹太社群约2,000人被公开烧死。自1348年春季起，欧洲各城市开始发生针对犹太人的大屠杀，最早见于土伦。同年11月，这些迫害经萨伏依扩散至德语地区。

en.s: The Battle of Uedahara (上田原の戦い) was the first defeat suffered by Takeda Shingen, and the first field battle in Japan in which firearms were used. It took place in Shinano Province or the modern-day Nagano Prefecture.

zh.s: 上田原之战是武田信玄首次战败，也是日本首次在野战中使用火器。战斗发生在信浓国，也就是今天的长野县。

en.s: The Mapuche uprising of 1655 (Spanish: alzamiento mapuche de 1655 or levantamiento mapuche de 1655) was a series of coordinated Mapuche attacks against Spanish settlements and forts in colonial Chile. It was the worst military crisis in Chile in decades, and contemporaries even considered the possibility of a civil war among the Spanish. The uprising marks the beginning of a ten-year period of warfare between the Spanish and the Mapuche.
en.n: The Mapuches launch coordinated attacks against the Spanish in Chile beginning the Mapuche uprising of 1655.

zh.s: 1655年马普切人起义（西班牙语：alzamiento mapuche de 1655或levantamiento mapuche de 1655）是一系列协调行动，马普切人同时袭击了殖民时期智利的西班牙定居点和堡垒。这是智利数十年来最严重的军事危机，当时的人甚至担心西班牙人之间会爆发内战。起义标志着西班牙人与马普切人之间长达十年的战争开始。
zh.n: 马普切人开始协调袭击智利的西班牙人，1655年马普切人起义由此爆发。

en.s: The Battle of Astarabad, otherwise known as the Battle of Ashraf was fought outside the city of Astarabad on 14 February 1759, between the forces of Karim Khan Zand, commanded by Shaykh Ali Khan Zand, and Mohammad Hasan Khan Qajar. The battle resulted in a total Qajar defeat and caused the death of Mohammad Hasan Khan Qajar, ending the Qajar threat to the Zand dynasty until the conquests of Agha Mohammad Khan Qajar.

zh.s: 1759年2月14日，卡里姆汗·赞德麾下、由谢赫·阿里汗·赞德指挥的部队，与穆罕默德·哈桑汗·卡扎尔在阿斯塔拉巴德城外交战，又称阿什拉夫战役。卡扎尔军彻底战败，穆罕默德·哈桑汗身亡。此后，卡扎尔势力对赞德王朝的威胁暂告结束，直至阿迦·穆罕默德汗·卡扎尔展开征服。

en.s: The Battle of Kettle Creek was the first major victory for Patriots in the back country of Georgia during the American Revolutionary War that took place on February 14, 1779. It was fought in Wilkes County about eleven miles (18 km) from present-day Washington, Georgia. A militia force of Patriots defeated and scattered a Loyalist militia force that was on its way to British-controlled Augusta.

zh.s: 凯特尔溪战役于1779年2月14日发生，是美国独立战争期间爱国者在佐治亚州内陆地区取得的首场重大胜利。战斗发生在威尔克斯县，距今华盛顿市约11英里（18公里）。爱国者民兵击败并驱散一支效忠派民兵队伍；后者原本正前往英军控制的奥古斯塔。

en.t: Battle of the Gulf of Roses
en.s: The Battle of the Gulf of Roses, also known as the action of 14 February 1795, was a minor naval engagement of the French Revolutionary Wars. It was fought in the Gulf of Roses between a ship of Juan de Lángara's fleet and a French squadron which consisted of a frigate and a corvette.

zh.s: 玫瑰湾海战又称1795年2月14日海战，是法国大革命战争期间的一场小规模海战。交战双方分别是一艘胡安·德·朗加拉舰队的军舰，以及由一艘护卫舰和一艘轻型护卫舰组成的法国分舰队。

en.s: The Battle of Cape St. Vincent was a fleet action fought on 14 February 1797 between the British and Spanish navies off Cape St. Vincent in Portugal as part of the War of the First Coalition. In one of the opening battles of the recently declared war between Britain and Spain, a British fleet under Admiral of the Blue Sir John Jervis defeated a larger Spanish fleet under Lieutenant-general José de Córdoba y Ramos which had left Cádiz to confront the British navy.

zh.s: 圣文森特角海战于1797年2月14日在葡萄牙圣文森特角外海爆发，是第一次反法同盟战争期间英国和西班牙海军的一次舰队交战。刚宣战不久，约翰·杰维斯爵士率领的英国舰队击败了规模更大的西班牙舰队。西班牙舰队由何塞·德·科尔多瓦·拉莫斯中将指挥，原从加的斯出发迎击英军。

en.s: The First Serbian Uprising was an uprising of Serbs in Orašac against the Dahije, and later the Ottoman Empire from 14 February 1804 to 7 October 1813. The uprising began as a local revolt against renegade janissary officers who had seized power in a coup d'état against the Ottoman sultan. It later evolved into a war for independence, known as the Serbian Revolution, after more than three centuries of Ottoman Empire rule and brief Austrian occupations.

zh.s: 第一次塞尔维亚起义发生于1804年2月14日至1813年10月7日。塞尔维亚人在奥拉沙茨起兵，最初反抗脱离奥斯曼帝国苏丹控制、通过政变夺权的禁卫军军官，后来转为争取独立的战争，史称塞尔维亚革命。此前，奥斯曼帝国已统治当地三百多年，其间还曾短暂被奥地利占领。

en.s: The Raid on Samaná was a land and naval action where two Royal Navy ships attacked the French held port of Samaná in Santo Domingo on 14 February 1807 during the Napoleonic Wars. They captured and burned a fort and then captured a number of ships which included two prizes with only light losses.

zh.s: 1807年2月14日，拿破仑战争期间，两艘英国皇家海军舰艇从海陆两面袭击法国控制的圣多明各萨马纳港。英军攻占并烧毁一座堡垒，随后夺取多艘船只，其中包括两艘此前被俘获的船，己方仅有轻微损失。

en.s: The Battle of Vauchamps (14 February 1814) was the final major engagement of the Six Days Campaign of the War of the Sixth Coalition. It resulted in a part of the Grande Armée under Napoleon I defeating a superior Prussian and Russian force of the Army of Silesia under Field-marshal Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher. At the beginning of 1814, the armies of the French Empire, under the direct command of Emperor Napoleon I, were scrambling to defend Eastern France against the invading Coalition Armies. Despite fighting against vastly superior forces, Napoleon managed to score a few significant victories and, between 10 and 13 February repeatedly beat Blücher’s Army of Silesia.

zh.s: 1814年2月14日，沃尚战役成为第六次反法同盟战争六日战役中最后一场重大交战。拿破仑一世率大军团的一部，击败布吕歇尔元帅指挥、兵力占优的西里西亚军团普俄部队。1814年初，拿破仑亲自指挥法兰西帝国军队，艰难抵御联军对法国东部的入侵。尽管敌军兵力远超己方，他仍取得数次重要胜利，并在2月10日至13日反复击败布吕歇尔的西里西亚军团。

en.s: The Battle of Debre Abbay was a conflict between Ras Marye of Yejju, Regent of the Emperor of Ethiopia, and his rival from Tigray, Dejazmach Sabagadis of Agame. Although Ras Marye lost his life in this battle, Dejazmach Sabagadis was defeated, and after surrendering was executed by Ras Marye's Oromo followers. Ras Marye had inherited the mantle of Regent of the Emperor of Ethiopia, and while admittedly a Christian, his Oromo ancestry caused much resentment from the other Christian aristocrats and nobles of Ethiopia. Dejazmach Sabagadis attempted to exploit this antipathy, and succeeded in forming a coalition with his fellow Christian lords of Gojjam, Lasta and Semien against Ras Marye.

zh.s: 德布雷阿拜战役交战双方为埃塞俄比亚皇帝摄政、耶朱的拉斯·马里，以及来自提格雷的对手、阿加梅的德贾兹马奇萨巴加迪斯。拉斯·马里虽然战死，萨巴加迪斯也遭击败，投降后被马里的奥罗莫追随者处决。马里继任皇帝摄政后，尽管信奉基督教，他的奥罗莫血统仍引起其他基督徒贵族强烈不满。萨巴加迪斯利用这种反感，联合戈贾姆、拉斯塔和瑟门的基督徒领主，共同反对马里。

en.s: Battle of Stoczek is the first significant fight of the November Uprising in Poland. It took place on 14 February 1831 near the town of Stoczek Łukowski, near the Brest-Warsaw road. Polish troops scared away 2 regiments of Russian mounted jaegers, inflicting some heavy casualties on them.

zh.s: 1831年2月14日，波兰十一月起义首场重要战斗，发生于布列斯特—华沙道路附近的斯托切克武科夫斯基镇一带。波军击退两个俄国骑马猎兵团，并使其遭受严重伤亡。

en.t: Siege of San José del Cabo
en.s: The siege of San José del Cabo, from January to February 1848, was a prolonged battle of the Mexican–American War in which Mexican militia besieged a smaller force of American marines, sailors and Californio militia. The final engagement during the battle involved half of the American garrison, and a landing party from a reinforcing warship, which successfully lifted the siege.

zh.s: 圣何塞德尔卡沃围城战发生于1848年1月至2月，是美墨战争期间的一场长期战斗。墨西哥民兵围困了规模较小的美军海军陆战队、水兵和加利福尼亚民兵。战斗最后一次交锋中，美军驻军一半兵力与前来增援的军舰登陆部队联手，成功解除围城。

en.t: Great Ormond St Hospital for Sick Children, the first hospital in England to provide in-patient beds specifically for children, is founded in London
en.s: Great Ormond Street Hospital (GOSH, formerly the Hospital for Sick Children) is a children's hospital in the London Borough of Camden, and a part of Great Ormond Street Hospital for Children NHS Foundation Trust. The hospital is situated between Great Ormond Street and Guilford Street, just inside Holborn's traditional boundary with Bloomsbury. The hospital is the largest centre for child heart surgery in Britain and one of the largest centres for heart transplantation in the world.

zh.t: 伦敦大奥蒙德街儿童医院成立，是英格兰首家专为儿童设有住院床位的医院
zh.s: 大奥蒙德街儿童医院（GOSH，旧称儿童医院）位于伦敦卡姆登区，隶属大奥蒙德街儿童医院国家医疗服务体系基金信托机构。医院坐落在大奥蒙德街和吉尔福德街之间，位于霍尔本与布卢姆斯伯里的传统分界线以内。它是英国规模最大的儿童心脏外科中心，也是世界上规模最大的心脏移植中心之一。

en.s: The Meridian campaign or Meridian expedition took place from February 14, 1864 – February 20, 1864, from Vicksburg, Mississippi to Meridian, Mississippi, by the Union Army of the Tennessee, led by Maj. Gen. William Tecumseh Sherman. Sherman captured Meridian, Mississippi, inflicting heavy damage to it. The campaign is viewed by historians as a prelude to Sherman's March to the Sea (Savannah campaign) in that a large swath of damage and destruction was inflicted on Central Mississippi as Sherman marched across the state and back.

zh.s: 梅里迪恩战役（又称梅里迪恩远征）于1864年2月14日至20日举行。田纳西联邦军由威廉·特库姆塞·谢尔曼少将率领，从密西西比州维克斯堡进军梅里迪恩，并攻占该城，造成严重破坏。历史学家认为，这场战役是谢尔曼向海进军（萨凡纳战役）的前奏；他往返穿越密西西比州中部时，沿途大片地区遭到破坏。

en.s: On 14 February 1879, Chilean forces occupied the port of Antofagasta, then administered by Bolivia, without resistance. The occupation preceded the formal declarations of war that followed in the War of the Pacific. Antofagasta is in present-day Chile.
en.n: This entry records the Chilean landing and occupation of Antofagasta on 14 February 1879, preceding the formal declarations of war.

zh.t: 智利军队占领安托法加斯塔
zh.s: 1879年2月14日，智利军队未遇抵抗，占领了当时由玻利维亚管辖的安托法加斯塔港。这次占领发生在南美太平洋战争各方正式宣战之前。安托法加斯塔现属智利。
zh.n: 此条记录的是1879年2月14日智利军队登陆并占领安托法加斯塔，时间早于各方正式宣战。

en.s: The Battle of Shipu (Chinese: 石浦海戰) was a French naval victory during the Sino-French War (August 1884–April 1885). The battle took place on the night of 14 February 1885 in Shipu Bay (石浦灣), near Ningbo, China.

zh.s: 1885年2月14日夜间，中法战争期间，中国宁波附近的石浦湾发生海战，以法国海军获胜告终。中法战争从1884年8月持续至1885年4月。

en.s: The Battle of Tugela (or Thukela) Heights, also known as the Battle of Pieters Hill, Battle of the Pieters, or the Battle of the Tugela River, consisted of a series of military actions lasting from 14 February through to 27 February 1900 in which General Sir Redvers Buller's British army forced Louis Botha's Boer army to lift the Siege of Ladysmith during the Second Boer War.

zh.s: 图盖拉（或图凯拉）高地战役又称彼得斯山战役、彼得斯战役或图盖拉河战役，是一系列军事行动，于1900年2月14日至27日进行。第二次布尔战争期间，雷德弗斯·布勒爵士将军率领的英军迫使路易斯·博塔率领的布尔军解除对莱迪史密斯的围困。

en.t: The United States Department of Commerce and Labor is established (later split into the Department of Commerce and the Department of Labor)
en.s: The United States Department of Commerce and Labor was a short-lived Cabinet department of the United States government, which was concerned with fostering and supervising big business. It existed from 1903 to 1913. The United States Department of Commerce is its successor agency, and it also is the predecessor of the United States Department of Labor.

zh.t: 美国商务与劳工部成立（后拆分为商务部和劳工部）
zh.s: 美国商务与劳工部是美国政府一个存在时间较短的内阁部门，负责扶持和监管大型企业。该部门于1903年至1913年间存在。美国商务部是其继任机构，劳工部则是其前身。

en.s: The Battle of Bereza Kartuska was fought between the Second Polish Republic and Soviet Russia around the village Bereza Kartuska (now Byaroza, Belarus) first on 14 February 1919, and again between 21 and 26 July 1920. The first skirmish of Bereza is considered to be the initial engagement of the Polish–Soviet War of 1919–1921 by some historians.

zh.t: 别列扎卡尔图斯卡战役
zh.s: 波兰第二共和国与苏俄先于1919年2月14日，后又于1920年7月21日至26日，在别列扎卡尔图斯卡村附近交战，该地今天是白俄罗斯别廖扎。部分历史学家认为，首次别列扎冲突是1919—1921年波苏战争的开端。

en.s: The Polish–Soviet War (14 February 1919 – 18 March 1921) was fought primarily between the Second Polish Republic and the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic, following World War I and the Russian Revolution. After the collapse of the Central Powers and the Armistice of 11 November 1918, Vladimir Lenin's Soviet Russia annulled the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk and moved forces westward to reclaim the Ober Ost regions abandoned by the Germans.

zh.s: 波苏战争（1919年2月14日—1921年3月18日）主要是波兰第二共和国与俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国之间的战争，发生在第一次世界大战和俄国革命之后。中欧同盟国战败、1918年11月11日停战后，列宁领导的苏俄宣布废除《布列斯特-立托夫斯克条约》，并向西推进，试图收复德国撤离的上奥斯特地区。

en.t: The League of Women Voters is founded in Chicago
en.s: The League of Women Voters (LWV) is a non-partisan American nonprofit political organization. Founded in 1920, its ongoing major activities include registering voters, providing voter information, boosting voter turnout and advocating for voting rights. In addition, the LWV works with partners for specific campaigns including support for campaign finance reform, women's rights, health care reform and gun control.

zh.t: 美国妇女选民联盟在芝加哥成立
zh.s: 美国妇女选民联盟（LWV）是一个无党派的美国非营利政治组织，成立于1920年。该组织长期开展的主要工作包括选民登记、提供选举信息、提高投票率和倡导投票权。它还与合作伙伴开展专项活动，推动竞选经费改革、妇女权利、医疗改革和枪支管制。

en.s: The Battle of Volochayevka was an important battle of the Far Eastern Front in the latter part of the Russian Civil War. It occurred on February 10 through 12, 1922, near Volochayevka station on the Amur Railway, on the outskirts of the city of Khabarovsk. The People's Revolutionary Army of the Far Eastern Republic under Vasily Blyukher defeated units of the counterrevolutionary Far Eastern White Army led by Viktorin Molchanov.

zh.s: 沃洛恰耶夫卡战役是俄国内战后期远东战线的一场重要战役，于1922年2月10日至12日在哈巴罗夫斯克郊外、阿穆尔铁路沃洛恰耶夫卡车站附近发生。瓦西里·布柳赫尔率领的远东共和国人民革命军击败了维克托林·莫尔恰诺夫率领的反革命远东白军部队。

en.s: The Saint Valentine's Day Massacre was the murder of seven members and associates of Chicago's North Side Gang on Saint Valentine's Day 1929. The men were gathered at a Lincoln Park, Chicago, garage when between four and six men entered, two of whom were disguised as police officers.

zh.s: 圣瓦伦丁节大屠杀发生于1929年圣瓦伦丁节，当天芝加哥北区帮派的7名成员及其同伙遭到杀害。这些人聚集在芝加哥林肯公园的一处车库时，4至6名男子闯入，其中两人伪装成警察。

en.s: General elections were held in Costa Rica on 14 February 1932. Ricardo Jiménez Oreamuno of the Independent National Republican Party won the presidential election, whilst the party also won the parliamentary election, in which they received 46.7% of the vote. Voter turnout was 64.2%.

zh.s: 哥斯达黎加于1932年2月14日举行大选。独立民族共和党的里卡多·希门尼斯·奥雷亚穆诺赢得总统选举，该党也以46.7%的得票率赢得议会选举。投票率为64.2%。

en.t: World War II: German battleship Bismarck is launched
en.s: Bismarck was the first of two Bismarck-class battleships built for Nazi Germany's Kriegsmarine. Named after Chancellor Otto von Bismarck, the ship was laid down at the Blohm & Voss shipyard in Hamburg in July 1936 and launched in February 1939. Work was completed in August 1940, when she was commissioned into the German fleet.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：德国战列舰俾斯麦号下水
zh.s: 俾斯麦号是纳粹德国海军建造的两艘俾斯麦级战列舰中的首舰。该舰以德国首相奥托·冯·俾斯麦命名，1936年7月在汉堡布洛姆与福斯船厂铺设龙骨，1939年2月下水。1940年8月完工并编入德国舰队。

en.s: The Battle of Bilin River was among the early major battles of the Burma Campaign in World War II. Fought between 14 and 19 February 1942, the battle was a tactical victory for Japan over the British Indian Army, and it led to a decisive victory for Japan immediately afterwards at the Battle of Sittang Bridge.

zh.s: 比林河战役是第二次世界大战缅甸战役初期的主要战役之一，发生于1942年2月14日至19日。日本军队在战术上击败英属印度军队，随后又在锡当河大桥战役中取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Sidi Bou Zid (Unternehmen Frühlingswind/Operation Spring Breeze) took place during the Tunisia Campaign from 14–17 February 1943, in World War II. The battle was fought around Sidi Bou Zid, where a large number of American units were mauled by German and Italian forces. It resulted in the Axis recapturing the strategically important town of Sbeitla in central Tunisia. The success at Sidi Bou Zid was reversed by April by counter-attacks by British and American forces. The battle was planned by the Germans to be a two-part offensive-defensive operation against US positions in western Tunisia.

zh.s: 1943年2月14日至17日，二战突尼斯战役期间，双方在西迪布济德附近交战，德方行动代号为“春风”。大量美军部队被德意军队重创，轴心国因此夺回突尼斯中部战略重镇斯贝特拉。不过到4月，英美反攻已扭转轴心国在西迪布济德取得的优势。德军原计划以两个阶段的攻防行动，打击突尼斯西部美军阵地。

en.s: The action of 14 February 1944 refers to the sinking of a German U-boat off the Strait of Malacca during World War II by a British submarine. It was one of the few naval engagements of the Asian and Pacific theater involving German and Italian forces.

zh.s: 1944年2月14日，第二次世界大战期间，一艘英国潜艇在马六甲海峡附近击沉一艘德国U型潜艇。这是亚洲及太平洋战区少数涉及德国和意大利军队的海战之一。

en.s: The Battle of Zabłocie (Polish: Bitwa pod Zabłocami, Ukrainian: Бій під Заблоцями; 14 February 1944) was fought between the 348th Platoon “Kirgiz” and Battalion “Ryś” of the Peasant Battalions and Platoon “Hardy” of the Home Army under the command of Stanisław Basaj and Mieczysław Olszak against the Third Reich, Ukrainian Auxiliary Police, 14th Grenadier Division of the Waffen–SS “Galizien”, and the German Gendarmerie in the Hrubieszów County of the Lublin Voivodeship.

zh.s: 扎布沃采战役（波兰语：Bitwa pod Zabłocami；乌克兰语：Бій під Заблоцями）于1944年2月14日发生。交战一方是波兰农民营“吉尔吉斯”排和“里希”营，以及由斯坦尼斯瓦夫·巴萨伊和梅奇斯瓦夫·奥尔沙克指挥的波兰家乡军“哈迪”排；另一方是第三帝国、乌克兰辅助警察、武装党卫军“加利西亚”第14掷弹兵师和德国宪兵队。

en.s: The PETA revolt in Blitar (Indonesian: Pemberontakan PETA di Blitar) was an anti-occupation revolt in present-day Indonesia, which took place on 14 February 1945 by the PETA daidan (battalion) in Blitar. This revolt was widely known as the first major uprising of local armies in Indonesia during the Japanese occupation. The revolt ended unsuccessfully; most of the rebels abandoned the attack, or were captured or killed by the Japanese.

zh.s: 布利塔尔PETA起义是印尼现今地区的一场反占领起义，于1945年2月14日由布利塔尔的PETA大队发动。这场起义被广泛认为是日本占领时期印尼地方军队发动的第一次重大起义。起义最终失败，大部分起义者放弃进攻、被俘或遭日军杀害。

en.s: Prague, the capital and largest city of the German-occupied Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia, was bombed several times by the Allies during World War II. The first Allied aircraft to fly over Prague was a single bomber of the French Air Force in April 1940, but it dropped propaganda leaflets, not bombs. The first bombing mission was flown by the Royal Air Force (RAF) in October 1941.
en.n: World War II: Navigational error leads to the mistaken bombing of Prague, Czechoslovakia by a United States Army Air Forces squadron of B-17s assisting in the Soviet Red Army's Vistula–Oder Offensive.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，盟军曾多次轰炸德国占领下的波希米亚和摩拉维亚保护国首府、最大城市布拉格。1940年4月，法国空军的一架轰炸机首次飞越布拉格，但只投下宣传传单，没有投弹。首次轰炸任务由英国皇家空军于1941年10月执行。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战期间，一支支援苏联红军维斯瓦河—奥得河攻势的美国陆军航空军B-17轰炸机编队因导航失误，误炸了捷克斯洛伐克首都布拉格。

en.s: The Asbestos strike of 1949, based in and around the town of Asbestos, Quebec, Canada, was a four-month labour dispute by asbestos miners. It has traditionally been portrayed as a turning point in Quebec history that helped lead to the Quiet Revolution. It also helped launch the careers of Jean Marchand, Gérard Pelletier, and Pierre Trudeau.
en.n: The Asbestos Strike begins in Canada. The strike marks the beginning of the Quiet Revolution in Quebec.

zh.s: 1949年石棉矿工罢工发生在加拿大魁北克省石棉镇及周边地区，是一场持续四个月的矿工劳资纠纷。传统观点认为，这场罢工是魁北克历史的转折点之一，并推动了后来的静默革命。让·马尔尚、热拉尔·佩尔蒂耶和皮埃尔·特鲁多也由此开启了政治生涯。
zh.n: 加拿大石棉矿工罢工开始。这场罢工标志着魁北克静默革命的开端。

en.t: Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance
en.s: The Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance (Russian: Советско-китайский договор о дружбе, союзе и взаимной помощи, simplified Chinese: 中苏友好同盟互助条约; traditional Chinese: 中蘇友好同盟互助條約; pinyin: Zhōng-Sū Yǒuhǎo Tóngméng Hùzhù Tiáoyuē), or Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance for short, was a bilateral treaty of alliance, collective security, aid and cooperation concluded between the People's Republic of China and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics on February 14, 1950.

zh.s: 《中苏友好同盟互助条约》（俄语：Советско-китайский договор о дружбе, союзе и взаимной помощи；简体中文：中苏友好同盟互助条约；繁体中文：中蘇友好同盟互助條約；拼音：Zhōng-Sū Yǒuhǎo Tóngméng Hùzhù Tiáoyuē）又简称《中苏友好同盟条约》，是中华人民共和国与苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟于1950年2月14日缔结的双边条约，涉及结盟、集体安全、援助与合作。

en.s: The Battle of Chipyong-ni (French: Bataille de Chipyong-ni), also known as the Battle of Dipingli (Chinese: 砥平里战斗; pinyin: Dǐpínglǐ Zhàndòu), was a decisive battle of the Korean War that took place from 13 to 14 February 1951 between US and French units of the US 23rd Infantry Regiment and various units of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army (PVA) around the village of Chipyong-ni.

en.s: The 1952 Winter Olympics, officially known as the VI Olympic Winter Games (Norwegian: De 6. olympiske vinterleker; Nynorsk: Dei 6. olympiske vinterleikane) and commonly known as Oslo 1952, were a winter multi-sport event held from 14 to 25 February 1952 in Oslo, the capital of Norway. Discussions about Oslo hosting the Winter Olympic Games began as early as 1935; the city was keen to host the 1948 Winter Olympics, but that was made impossible by World War II.

zh.s: 1952年冬季奥运会正式名称为第六届冬季奥林匹克运动会，通常称为“奥斯陆1952”。这场冬季综合体育赛事于1952年2月14日至25日在挪威首都奥斯陆举行。早在1935年，奥斯陆就开始讨论申办冬奥会，并曾希望承办1948年冬奥会，但因第二次世界大战而未能实现。

en.s: Elections were held in the state of Western Australia on 14 February 1953 to elect all 50 members to the Legislative Assembly. The two-term Liberal-Country Party coalition government, led by Premier Sir Ross McLarty, was defeated by the Labor Party, led by Opposition Leader Albert Hawke. The election was notable in that 22 of the 50 seats were not contested at the election.

zh.s: 西澳大利亚州于1953年2月14日举行选举，选出立法会的全部50名议员。由州长罗斯·麦克拉蒂爵士领导的自由党—乡村党联合政府执政两届后败给由反对党领袖阿尔伯特·霍克领导的工党。此次选举有22个席位没有候选人参选。

en.s: The 1953 New South Wales state election was held on 14 February 1953. It was conducted in single member constituencies with compulsory preferential voting and was held on boundaries created at a 1952 redistribution. The election was for all of the 94 seats in the Legislative Assembly.

en.s: On 14 February 1956, the Twentieth Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union opened. Nikita Khrushchev’s later closed-session speech criticizing Stalin’s personality cult was delivered on February25, not on opening day.

zh.t: 苏共第二十次代表大会开幕
zh.s: 1956年2月14日，苏联共产党第二十次代表大会开幕。赫鲁晓夫批评斯大林个人崇拜的秘密报告，是在2月25日的闭门会议上发表，并非开幕当天。

en.t: The Federation was formed on 14 February 1958, when King Faisal II of Iraq and his cousin, King Hussein of Jordan, sought to unite their two Hashemite kingdoms as a response to the formation of the United Arab Republic between Egypt and Syria
en.s: The Hashemite Arab Federation was a short-lived confederation that lasted from 14 February to 2 August 1958, between the Hashemite kingdoms of Iraq and Jordan. Although the name implies a federal structure, it was de facto a confederation. The Federation was formed on 14 February 1958, when King Faisal II of Iraq and his cousin, King Hussein of Jordan, sought to unite their two Hashemite kingdoms as a response to the formation of the United Arab Republic between Egypt and Syria.

zh.t: 哈希姆阿拉伯联邦成立
zh.s: 哈希姆阿拉伯联邦是伊拉克和约旦两个哈希姆王国组成的短期邦联，存在于1958年2月14日至8月2日。尽管名称中有“联邦”，它实际上是邦联。1958年2月14日，伊拉克国王费萨尔二世与堂兄、约旦国王侯赛因为应对埃及和叙利亚成立阿拉伯联合共和国而宣布合并两国。

en.s: General elections were held in Paraguay on 14 February 1988. Alfredo Stroessner of the Colorado Party won the presidential elections, whilst the Colorado Party won 20 of the 30 seats in the Senate and 40 of the 60 seats in the Chamber of Deputues. Voter turnout was 92.2%. These were the last elections under Stroessner, who had won every election since 1954 with more than 70% of the vote, as he was overthrown in a coup in February 1989. Fresh elections were held in May 1989, the first time the opposition had been able to contest elections for seberal years.

zh.s: 巴拉圭于1988年2月14日举行大选。红党的阿尔弗雷多·斯特罗斯纳赢得总统选举；红党还赢得参议院30席中的20席，以及众议院60席中的40席，投票率为92.2%。这是斯特罗斯纳统治下最后一次选举。他自1954年以来每次选举得票率均超过70%，但于1989年2月被政变推翻。同年5月重新举行选举，反对派在时隔多年后首次能够参与竞选。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Cyprus on 14 February 1988, with a second round on 21 February. They were the first presidential elections in the country's history to go to a second round, and resulted in a victory for George Vassiliou as an independent candidate supported by AKEL after he finished as the runner-up behind Glafcos Clerides of the Democratic Rally in the first round.

zh.s: 塞浦路斯于1988年2月14日举行总统选举，第二轮投票于2月21日举行。这是该国历史上首次需要进入第二轮的总统选举。得到劳动人民进步党支持的独立候选人乔治·瓦西利乌，首轮落后于民主大会党的格拉夫科斯·克莱里季斯，但最终赢得选举。

en.s: The Global Positioning System (GPS) is a satellite-based hyperbolic navigation system owned by the United States Space Force and operated by Mission Delta 31. It is one of the global navigation satellite systems (GNSS) that provide geolocation and time information to a GPS receiver anywhere on or near the Earth where signal quality permits.

zh.s: 全球定位系统（GPS）是由美国太空军拥有、由任务三角洲31部运营的卫星导航系统。它是全球卫星导航系统（GNSS）之一，可在地球表面或附近信号质量允许的范围内，为GPS接收器提供地理位置和时间信息。

en.s: Indian Airlines Flight 605 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Bombay to Bangalore. On 14 February 1990, an Airbus A320 registered as VT-EPN, crashed onto a golf course while attempting to land at Bangalore, killing 92 of 146 people on board. The Indian investigative team ruled that the probable cause was the pilots selecting the "Open descent/flight idle" control mode rather than "Glideslope capture", allowing the aircraft to sink far below the correct flight path.

zh.s: 印度航空605号班机是从孟买飞往班加罗尔的定期国内客运航班。1990年2月14日，一架注册号VT-EPN的空客A320尝试在班加罗尔降落时，坠入一座高尔夫球场，机上146人中92人死亡。印度调查组认定，可能原因是飞行员选择了“开放下降／飞行慢车”控制模式，而非“下滑道截获”模式，使飞机下降至正确飞行轨迹以下。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Lithuania on 14 February 1993. This was the first presidential election under the new Constitution of Lithuania of October 1992 and since the declaration of independence in March 1990. Algirdas Brazauskas, the former first secretary of the Communist Party of Lithuania and the then-current leader of the Democratic Labour Party of Lithuania (DLPL), won with over 60% of the vote. The runner up was Stasys Lozoraitis, an independent candidate endorsed by the Sąjūdis movement and other political parties.

zh.s: 立陶宛于1993年2月14日举行总统选举，这是1992年10月新宪法通过后，以及1990年3月宣布独立后首次总统选举。前立陶宛共产党第一书记、时任立陶宛民主劳动党领袖阿尔吉尔达斯·布拉藻斯卡斯，以超过60%的得票率获胜。获得“萨尤季斯”运动及其他政党支持的独立候选人斯塔西斯·洛佐赖蒂斯排名第二。

en.s: The international friendly between the Albania and Kosovo national football teams on 14 February 1993 was the first match played by Kosovo after the partition of Football Federation of Kosovo from Football Association of Yugoslavia. zh.t: 1993年阿尔巴尼亚—科索沃足球赛
zh.s: 阿尔巴尼亚与科索沃国家队于1993年2月14日举行了一场国际友谊赛，这是科索沃足球联合会脱离南斯拉夫足球协会后，科索沃参加的首场比赛。比赛在阿尔巴尼亚地拉那的塞尔曼·斯特尔马西体育场举行，现场有14,000名观众。

en.t: St. Valentine's Day Massacre: In Your House
en.s: St. Valentine's Day Massacre: In Your House was a 1999 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the 27th In Your House and took place on February 14, 1999, at the Memphis Pyramid in Memphis, Tennessee. en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Ogmore was held on 14 February 2002, triggered by the death of incumbent Labour Party MP Sir Raymond Powell on 7 December 2001. It was won by Huw Irranca-Davies, who held the seat for Labour. Labour faced no realistic challenge in this very safe seat and retained it easily, with only Plaid Cymru making progress from their 2001 result.

en.s: The 2002 Uttaranchal Legislative Assembly election were the 1st Vidhan Sabha (Legislative Assembly) elections of the state of Uttaranchal in India, when the Indian National Congress emerged as the largest party and won a majority with 36 seats in the 70-seat legislature in the election. The Bharatiya Janata Party became the official opposition, holding 19 seats. This was the first time state assembly elections were held in Uttarakhand.

zh.t: 2002年北阿坎德邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 2002年北阿坎德邦举行了首届邦议会选举。印度国大党成为第一大党，并在70席的议会中赢得36席，取得多数；印度人民党获得19席，成为正式反对党。这也是北阿坎德邦首次举行邦议会选举。

en.t: Hans Blix briefs the Security Council on Iraq inspections
en.s: On 14 February 2003, Hans Blix briefed the UN Security Council in New York, United States, on weapons inspections in Iraq. He said UNMOVIC had so far found no weapons of mass destruction, only a small number of empty chemical munitions, while unresolved disarmament questions remained.

zh.t: 布利克斯向安理会汇报伊拉克武器核查情况
zh.s: 2003年2月14日，汉斯·布利克斯在美国纽约向联合国安理会汇报伊拉克武器核查情况。他表示，联合国监核视委截至当时尚未发现大规模杀伤性武器，只找到少量空的化学弹药；裁军核查仍有未解决的问题。

en.s: ROH 2nd Anniversary Show was the second ROH Anniversary Show professional wrestling event produced by Ring of Honor (ROH). It took place on February 14, 2004, at the National Guard Armory in Braintree, Massachusetts. The show featured a tournament to crown the inaugural Pure Wrestling Champion, with A.J. Styles defeating CM Punk in the tournament final to become the first Pure Wrestling Champion.

zh.t: 荣誉之戒两周年纪念大赛
zh.s: 荣誉之戒两周年纪念大赛，是荣誉之戒（ROH）制作的第二届周年职业摔角赛事，于2004年2月14日在美国马萨诸塞州布伦特里国民警卫队军械库举行。赛事通过锦标赛决出首位纯粹摔角冠军，A.J.斯泰尔斯在决赛中击败CM Punk，成为首任冠军。

en.s: The 2004 Nevada Democratic presidential caucuses took place on February 14, 2004, as part of the 2004 United States Democratic presidential primaries. The delegate allocation is Proportional. The candidates were awarded delegates in proportion to the percentage of votes received and the caucus was open to registered Democrats only. A total of 20 delegates are awarded proportionally. A 15 percent threshold was required to receive delegates.

zh.s: 内华达州于2004年2月14日举行民主党总统党团会议，是当年美国民主党总统初选的一部分，仅限登记为民主党人的选民参加。20个代表名额按候选人得票比例分配，候选人须达到15%的得票门槛才有资格分得名额。

en.s: On 14 February 2005, former Prime Minister of Lebanon Rafic Hariri was assassinated along with 21 others in an explosion in Beirut, Lebanon. Explosives equivalent to around 1,000 kilograms (2,200 pounds) of TNT were detonated as his motorcade drove near the St. George Hotel. Among the dead were several of Hariri's bodyguards and former Minister of Economy and Trade Bassel Fleihan. Hariri had been part of the anti-Assad opposition in Lebanon. His assassination triggered the Cedar Revolution, a popular movement which forced Syria to withdraw all its troops in Lebanon by April 2005.

zh.s: 2005年2月14日，黎巴嫩前总理拉菲克·哈里里在贝鲁特遇刺，他与另外21人死于爆炸。他的车队驶近圣乔治酒店时，相当于约1000公斤（2200磅）TNT的炸药被引爆。死者包括多名保镖及前经济贸易部长巴塞勒·弗莱汉。哈里里是黎巴嫩反阿萨德反对派的一员。他遇刺后引发雪松革命，这场民众运动迫使叙利亚于2005年4月前撤出驻黎全部军队。

en.s: The Sunjiawan mine disaster (Chinese: 孙家湾矿难) was a mine disaster that occurred on 14 February 2005 in Fuxin city, Liaoning province, in the northeastern part of the People's Republic of China. Initial reports indicated that at least 214 coal miners were killed, making it the worst mining disaster in China in at least 15 years.

zh.s: 2005年2月14日，中国东北部辽宁省阜新市发生孙家湾矿难。初步报告称至少214名煤矿工人遇难，是中国至少15年来最严重的矿难。

en.s: The 2006 Fort Lauderdale mayoral election took place on February 14, 2006. Incumbent Mayor Jim Naugle ran for re-election to a sixth term. He was challenged by former Miramar City Commissioner Dan Lewis, a political consultant. Naugle defeated Lewis in a landslide, winning re-election with 64 percent of the vote.

en.s: The 2019 Pulwama attack occurred on 14 February 2019, when a convoy of vehicles carrying Indian security personnel on the Jammu–Srinagar National Highway was attacked by a vehicle-borne suicide bomber at Lethapora in the Pulwama district of the erstwhile state of Jammu and Kashmir. The attack killed 40 Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) personnel as well as the perpetrator — Adil Ahmad Dar— who was a local Kashmiri youth from the Pulwama district. The responsibility for the attack was claimed by the Pakistan-based Islamist terrorist group, Jaish-e-Mohammed. India blamed neighbouring Pakistan for the attack, while the latter condemned the attack and denied having any connections to it.

en.t: CMLL Torneo Nacional de Parejas Increíbles (2020)
en.s: The CMLL Torneo Nacional de Parejas Increíbles (2020) or the National Incredible Pairs Tournament (2020) was the 2020 version of an annual professional wrestling tag team tournament held by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL). The tournament is based on the Lucha Libre Parejas Increíbles match concept, which pairs two wrestlers of opposite allegiance, one portraying a rudo, the antagonists of professional wrestling, and one portraying a técnicotécnico, the protagonist of professional wrestling The 2020 version of the tournament is the eleventh year in a row that CMLL held the tournament since the first tournament in 2010. The winners are presented with a trophy but not given any other tangible reward for the victory. The tournament started with the first block of eight teams on February 14, 2020, and ran over three Super Viernes shows.

zh.s: 2020年全国奇妙搭档锦标赛，是墨西哥世界摔角理事会（CMLL）举办的年度职业摔角双人组队赛事。赛事采用墨式摔角“奇妙搭档”概念，让分属对立阵营的两名选手配对：一人扮演反派，一人扮演正派。这是该组织自2010年首办以来，连续第11年举行比赛。冠军获得奖杯，但没有其他实物奖励。赛事于2020年2月14日从首组八支队伍的比赛开始，跨三场“超级星期五”节目进行。

en.s: The 2020 CAF Super Cup (officially the 2020 Total CAF Super Cup for sponsorship reasons) was the 28th CAF Super Cup, an annual football match in Africa organized by the Confederation of African Football (CAF), between the winners of the previous season's two CAF club competitions, the CAF Champions League and the CAF Confederation Cup. The match was played between Espérance de Tunis from Tunisia, the 2018–19 CAF Champions League winners, and Zamalek from Egypt, the 2018–19 CAF Confederation Cup winners, at the Thani bin Jassim Stadium in Doha, Qatar on 14 February 2020.

zh.s: 2020年非洲超级杯因赞助正式称为道达尔非洲超级杯，是第28届赛事。非洲足联每年组织这场比赛，由上赛季非洲冠军联赛及非洲联合会杯冠军交锋。本届由2018—2019赛季非洲冠军联赛冠军突尼斯希望队，对阵同赛季非洲联合会杯冠军埃及扎马雷克，比赛于2020年2月14日在卡塔尔多哈萨尼·本·贾西姆体育场举行。

en.s: NXT TakeOver: Vengeance Day was a 2021 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held exclusively for wrestlers from the promotion's NXT brand division. It was simultaneously the 33rd NXT TakeOver event and the ninth Vengeance. Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the event took place on February 14, 2021, from the Capitol Wrestling Center, a bio-secure bubble that was hosted at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida.

zh.s: NXT接管：复仇日是WWE于2021年举办的职业摔角按次付费及网络直播赛事，专供NXT品牌选手参赛。这既是第33场NXT接管赛事，也是复仇系列第九届。受新冠疫情影响，赛事于2021年2月14日在美国佛罗里达州奥兰多WWE训练中心内的国会摔角中心举行，该场地采用封闭防疫管理。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in the Indian state of Punjab on 14 February 2021; the result was declared on 17 February. The elections are scheduled for 117 urban local bodies, including 8 municipal corporations and 109 municipal councils and nagar panchayats. Elections were originally scheduled to be held in October 2020, but were delayed because of the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.s: 印度旁遮普邦于2021年2月14日举行市政选举，17日公布结果。选举涉及117个城市地方机构，包括八个市政公司，以及109个市议会和城镇委员会。选举原定于2020年10月举行，因新冠疫情而推迟。

en.s: A regional election was held in Catalonia on 14 February 2021 to elect the 13th/14th Parliament of the autonomous community. All 135 seats in the Parliament were up for election. After the 2017 election, pro-Catalan independence parties secured a parliamentary majority, electing Quim Torra as new Catalan president after attempts to have Carles Puigdemont and Jordi Turull elected to the office were foiled by Spanish courts.

zh.s: 加泰罗尼亚于2021年2月14日举行自治区选举，选出第13/14届自治区议会的135名议员。2017年选举后，支持加泰罗尼亚独立的政党获得议会多数，并在法院阻止卡莱斯·普伊格德蒙特和霍尔迪·图鲁尔当选后，推举基姆·托拉担任加泰罗尼亚主席。

en.s: Operation Claw-Eagle 2 (Turkish: Pençe Kartal-2 Harekatı) was an air and ground operation launched by the Turkish Armed Forces against the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) in the Duhok Governorate of the Kurdistan Region of northern Iraq. According to Turkey, it was launched to secure the border between Turkey and Iraq and to eliminate the PKK in the area and to rescue Turkish hostages held by the PKK.

en.s: Legislative Assembly elections were held in Uttarakhand on 14 February 2022 to elect 70 members of the Uttarakhand Legislative Assembly. The votes were counted and the results were declared on 10 March 2022. It was the first time an incumbent government got re-elected after the creation of Uttarakhand. The Bharatiya Janata Party formed the government for a second consecutive term with 47 seats, despite losing 10 seats.

zh.s: 印度北阿坎德邦于2022年2月14日举行邦议会选举，选出70名议员，并于3月10日计票、公布结果。这是该邦成立以来，现任政府首次赢得连任。印度人民党虽然减少十席，仍以47席连续第二次组建政府。

en.s: General elections were held in Indonesia on 14 February 2024 to elect the president, vice president, and People's Consultative Assembly (MPR), which consists of the House of Representatives (DPR), the Regional Representative Council (DPD), and members of local legislative bodies (DPRD) at the provincial and city or regency levels. The newly elected members of the MPR were sworn in on 1 October 2024, while the elected president and vice president was sworn in on 20 October 2024.

zh.s: 印度尼西亚于2024年2月14日举行大选，选举总统、副总统、人民协商会议（MPR）议员；人民协商会议由人民代表会议（DPR）、地方代表理事会（DPD）及省、市和县级地方立法机构（DPRD）的议员组成。新当选的人民协商会议议员于2024年10月1日宣誓就职，新当选的正、副总统则于10月20日宣誓就职。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Indonesia on 14 February 2024 with defence minister and former general Prabowo Subianto contesting the elections against the former governor of Jakarta, Anies Baswedan and the former governor of Central Java, Ganjar Pranowo; incumbent president Joko Widodo was constitutionally barred from seeking a third term in office. On 20 March, the General Elections Commission (KPU) announced Prabowo's victory, having received over 96 million votes.

zh.s: 印度尼西亚于2024年2月14日举行总统选举，国防部长、前将军普拉博沃·苏比安托与雅加达前省长阿尼斯·巴斯韦丹、中爪哇前省长甘贾尔·普拉诺沃角逐总统职位。现任总统佐科·维多多受宪法限制，不能寻求第三个任期。3月20日，选举委员会（KPU）宣布普拉博沃获胜，他获得超过9,600万张选票。

en.s: The Chapter 176: For The Love of Progress 3 was a professional wrestling event produced by Progress Wrestling. It took place on 14 February 2025, in Manchester, England, at the Bowlers BEC Arena. Seven matches were contested at the event. The main event saw Simon Miller defeat Charles Crowley to retain the Progress Proteus Championship.
